shared_elements: schematic incised/pecked linear motifs on stone
repeated small vertical strokes in a row
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic linear carvings including rows of repeated short vertical strokes — in A as bands of vertical marks and rounded bosses on a sculpted anthropomorphic torso, in B as the crew-strokes of a boat with upturned prows. The subject matter is fundamentally different: A depicts a large human-like figure with a head, shoulders, discs and belt-like bands arranged on a three-dimensional body, while B depicts a single profile watercraft plus small ancillary boat and animal-like signs scattered on a flat rock face.
